ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60% low-intensity (black) to 40% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black geometric region originating from the peduncle and flaring upwards to the trailing edge. High-intensity white fields are located on the distal lateral lobes. Fine-grained black mottling and focal spots (1-5 pixel diameter) are visible within the white fields and along the pigment transition boundaries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 75 degrees and a significant bounding-box depth relative to the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations; jagged peaks and valleys occur approximately every 10-20 horizontal pixels with varying amplitudes along the continuous trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve originating from the distal tips and terminating at the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme left and right distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel disruptions; one prominent diagonal mark on the left white lobe and multiple vertical/sub-vertical rake marks on the right white lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant clusters of sessile organisms (barnacles) on distal tips; multiple irregular nicks and jagged tissue loss along the serrated trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly symmetrical 'butterfly' pigmentation pattern centered on the median notch.
